title: じいちゃん、うるせえ
subject: a first-timer carrying the neighbourhood mikoshi at the summer matsuri in a borrowed happi coat while an old barber shouts corrections from the roadside
caption: Japanese ska-punk. A horn section of trumpet, trombone, tenor and baritone saxophones playing unison riffs and short stabs, an upstroke guitar skank on every offbeat in the verses, a bouncing pick-played bass, backbeat drums with rimshots and fast hi-hats that switch to a punk two-beat with distorted guitars under the horns in the chorus. Loud, live and a little roomy like a small club, the horns forward and bright, guitars and bass tight underneath. Male lead voice shouting the lines with a rough edge, with the band answering in gang choruses. 168 BPM, Bb major. Rowdy, sore-shouldered pride. No reggae one-drop, no synths, no autotune, no slow ballad section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - horn riff and offbeat guitar skank]

[Verse 1]
法被は 酒屋の兄ちゃんに借りた
袖が長くて 樟脳くさい
初めて入る 神輿の棒の下
右肩に 木がゴツンと乗っかる

[Pre-Chorus - band answers]
「肩 入れろ!」
床屋のじいちゃんが 沿道から叫ぶ
入れてるって!

[Chorus - lead calls, band answers]
わっしょい! わっしょい!
肩が痛え でも声は出す
わっしょい! わっしょい!
じいちゃん うるせえ 今やってる

[Verse 2]
鳥居の前で 一回下ろして 麦茶を飲む
肩は紫 タオル畳んで 挟み直す
「代わるか?」って聞かれて 首を振った
いつの間にか 前の人と 足が揃ってる

[Chorus - lead calls, band answers]
わっしょい! わっしょい!
肩が痛え でも声は出す
わっしょい! わっしょい!
じいちゃん 黙った 腕組んで 笑ってる

[Outro - horn stabs, cut]
法被を返しに行ったら じいちゃんが一言
「来年は 先棒な」
[Song ends abruptly]
